body:
## Summary

Implements the issue-first, zero-credential episode-ingest pipeline agreed in #76. A scheduled collector detects newly published podcast episodes from the [Anchor RSS feed](https://anchor.fm/s/10dbf5b7c/podcast/rss) and files a templated `@sepo-agent /implement` issue (mirroring #31/#75) so the existing `agent-router` → `agent-implement` pipeline opens the website PR for review.

- **`.agent/src/episode-ingest.ts`** — pure, dependency-free logic: parse the feed, detect the lowest-numbered episode not yet under `content/episodes/epNN.md`, convert the HTML description to readable text, and derive external links with **no API keys**:
  - Apple Podcasts → iTunes Lookup API, matched on `episodeGuid`
  - Spotify → server-rendered `open.spotify.com/embed/show/...` `__NEXT_DATA__`
  - YouTube → `yt-dlp` channel listing, title-matched with a most-recent-upload fallback
- **`.agent/src/cli/episode-ingest.ts`** — fetches the sources, downloads the cover, and emits Action outputs. Every lookup degrades gracefully: a missing link is flagged in the issue rather than failing the run.
- **`.github/workflows/agent-episode-ingest.yml`** — hourly `schedule` + `workflow_dispatch`; installs `yt-dlp`, runs the collector, dedupes against existing issues by title, and files the `/implement` issue using the resolved agent token so the router picks it up.
- **`.agent/src/__tests__/episode-ingest.test.ts`** — 10 unit tests over an RSS fixture covering parsing, dedup, description conversion, and link extraction/matching.

## Verification

- `npm run build` clean; full `.agent` suite green (723 tests, including the 10 new ones).
- Live end-to-end dry run against the real feed detected episode 5 and produced links identical to those hand-filed in #75 — YouTube `Vh_j64tVGFQ`, Spotify `7GRrw4m3GDq4thvQUff4TV`, Apple `i=1000771878436` — plus a 3000×3000 cover download.
- Workflow YAML parse, `gh`-token lint, and `git diff --check` all pass.

## Notes

- No secrets are stored in the repo. The YouTube Data API key discussed in #76 remains a backup only if `yt-dlp` is ever hard-blocked from CI.
- The collector is deterministic; the episode page, guest page, cross-links, and cover commit are handled by the existing agent pipeline from the generated issue.

Closes #76
title: Automate new-episode ingest from podcast RSS feed
